prompt:
Subject: overwork, target meaning "過度に働かせる".

Composition: Show an exhausted office worker hunched over a crowded desk after dark, rubbing tired eyes beside a dim desk lamp and unfinished papers.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use only the attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Clean smooth solid color fills and a few flat cartoon shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Material texture must use only a few deliberate bold smooth shapes. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands; hands and wrists connect naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows.
en: Too much overwork leaves the office worker exhausted.
ja: 仕事のしすぎで会社員が疲れ切っている。
